verdict.rationale: Superset has a hosted backend, so data residency is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents choosing a storage region or residency. The only related claim is that it is local-first and code stays on the machine unless you say so. That is an adjacent privacy property, not region or residency selection for synced or hosted data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
